notes_for_editor: Thin record. The name in the index is 'mt vernon?' with a question mark, and it is the only source that mentions a tower here. Two WebSearch calls (Mt. Vernon fire tower; Montgomery County and Fire Tower Road) returned only county pages and an unrelated Chenocetah item; the NHLR Georgia index and the Vanishing Georgia tag pages do not list this site.
